relationships.subject: Quercetin
relationships.evidence_quote: QUE markedly alleviated the joint pain induced by ACLT in rats, with a therapeutic efficacy comparable to celecoxib

key_findings: Quercetin protects chondrocytes and cartilage in ACLT rats by activating SIRT1/Nrf2/HO-1 and suppressing ferroptosis.
SIRT1 inhibition with EX527 reversed quercetin's effects on Nrf2/HO-1, GPX4 and ferritin.
